Updatable fields: `customerNickname`, `email`, `description`, `phoneNumber`.

get.description: Returns all agents associated with the authenticated account.
Returns a single agent by ID (email). Path `id` must be URL-encoded.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Agent email address (agent ID). Must be URL-encoded when used in the path (for example, encode `@` as `%40`).

get.description: Returns a flat paginated list of AI agents for the authenticated business. Pass `flat=true` to skip folder grouping. Distinct from human agents under `/agents`.

parameters.name: flat
parameters.description: Must be `true` to return a flat agent list (no folders).

parameters.name: getFiles
parameters.description: When `true`, loads vector store files for each agent. Defaults to omitting file contents.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size. Defaults to 25.

parameters.name: exclusiveStartKey
parameters.description: URI-encoded JSON pagination cursor from a previous response `lastEvaluatedKey`.

get.description: Returns a single AI agent by ID, including vector store files when available. Path `id` must be URL-encoded.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: AI agent identifier. Must be URL-encoded when used in the path.

put.description:
Updates an AI agent. Supported fields: `name`, `description`, `roles`, and `vectorStore.required`. Changed roles regenerate their OpenAI function tools.

**Field length limits** (same as the Pingmee app; exceeding them returns `400`):

| Field | Max length |
| --- | --- |
| `description` | 5000 |
| `roles[].name` | 40 |
| `roles[].description` | 1500 |
| `roles[].instructions` | 1500 |
| `roles[].webhook` | 300 |

Path `id` must be URL-encoded.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: AI agent identifier. Must be URL-encoded when used in the path.

requestBody.description: Fields to update on the AI agent

GetMessagesRequest.description: Use `startKey` only after the first page: set it to `lastEvaluatedKey` from the prior response to fetch the next batch.

hasMoreItemsToFetch.description: Whether more messages exist beyond this page
